# Pakistan

> [!summary] Data available
> Pakistan is thinly covered: a few hundred recipes in large English corpora, a handful of dishes in inventories, and plant-level data in the global knowledge bases. Start with [[RecipeDB2]] and [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] for dishes, [[KNApSAcK Family]] and [[CMAUP]] for plants; the national FCT is only in the Backlog.

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈360 recipes (v1, region Indian Subcontinent); amounts, steps, nutrition, not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 141 recipes (steps, no amounts; user tags).
- [[IndicRecipeNutri]]: Sindhi 306 recipes (Region) / 180 (Cuisine), as cooked by the Sindhi diaspora in India; amounts and nutrition.
- Inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 43 dishes (only 2 Pakistan-only; most shared with India); [[FmLAMA]] 4; [[World Wide Dishes]] 3 (1 Pakistan-only).
- Not in [[BLEnD]].

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Pakistan Food Composition Table]] (2001 PDF; candidate, priority 2). [[South Asian Recipes with Nutrition]] lists Pakistan but may be synthetic (priority 3).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- Unani (Tibb) is the living tradition; the vault has it only through India-based sources ([[IMPPAT]] Unani 813 plants, [[CMAUP]] Unani 274) and the Persian materia medica [[UNaProd]] (labelled South Asia; synonyms include Sindhi).
- Per-country counts: [[KNApSAcK Family]] 230 records (147 edible / 83 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 183 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 35 records (incl. Baluchistan); [[NPASS]] 21 pairs.
- Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No Pakistan FCT, no native-language recipe corpus, no BLEnD culture; Pakistani dishes are mostly folded into "Indian Subcontinent" labels, and no Pakistan-specific Unani database exists.
